comment: Bytes, regression ceilings — tighten only. Set just above the measured values after the M3.5 spec-driven rework (engine 52259 min / 16345 gz). PLAN's aspirational 40KB-min engine is not reachable by refactoring: ~72% of the minified engine is string data (the Tailwind v4 property/keyword vocabulary and the packed statics table), leaving only ~14.5KB of actual code. The gz numbers are the network-relevant ones: full stack ~24KB gz vs ~200KB for the UnoCSS stack it replaces.
